name: gradient-ascent
description: Local-first cycling coaching, training-plan imports, activity history, recovery data, and dashboards for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Goals, plans, local data imports, notes, and cycling advice.
interface.longDescription: Gradient Ascent packages a local-first cycling workflow: formal goals, plan imports, official Strava and Garmin account archives, Apple Health exports, a local Training Center, persistent coach notes, and multi-lens coaching advice.
defaultPrompt: Use $gradient-ascent to set up coaching in this workspace.
Use $coach-setup-plan to import my training calendar and event plan.
Use $coach-setup-activities to import activity history from my Strava archive.
Use $coach-setup-recovery to import recovery and health exports.
Use $coach-setup-status to tell me what Gradient Ascent has configured and what matters next.
Use $coach-note to save this ride insight.
